newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy prelim CPI seen at 3.4 pct yr/yr in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Italy prelim CPI seen at 3.4 pct yr/yr in Sept.

text.p: Italian consumer prices are seen at 3.4 percent year on year in September and 0.3 percent month on month after data issued by six sample cities, analysts said.
Final Italian CPI stood at 3.4 percent year on year and rose 0.1 percent on a month on month basis in August.
The final four of 10 sample Italian cities release their preliminary data for September after 1530 GMT on Tuesday.
Final inflation data for September will be issued by statistics institute ISTAT on October 4.
